verdict.justification: The project integrates an emotional model proposed by Albert Mehrabian and an evolutionary model based on agents to simulate the diffusion of knowledge among emotional agents in a 2D virtual grid environment. The project is a multi-agent system where two reflex agents (predator agent and prey agent) and two emotional agents (explorer agent and settler agent) interact. The use of an emotional model and the focus on evolutionary simulation suggest that this project falls under Computer Science, specifically Artificial Intelligence.
